strategies.name: Opponent-adjusted margin
strategies.hypothesis: Shrink team strength toward league mean; fit score margin using lagged offense/defense, home court and opponent strength.
strategies.output: Distribution of home margin; derive spread cover and moneyline from the same coherent score distribution.
strategies.risk: Raw win percentage is NOT a matchup win probability. Full-season aggregates may seed a later season only, never earlier games.

strategies.name: Pace × efficiency total
strategies.hypothesis: Forecast possessions and both teams’ points per possession using prior-game data; allow their residuals to co-move.
strategies.output: μ_total = E[possessions × (PPP_home + PPP_away)]; integrate a calibrated distribution at the offered total.
strategies.risk: PTS_home average + PTS_away average is not an opponent-adjusted total model. Overtime and pushes must match operator rules.

strategies.name: Schedule & availability update
strategies.hypothesis: Fit rest and back-to-back effects as covariates; timestamp official injury reports and roster changes.
strategies.output: Update score/participation distributions at a fixed pregame cutoff; abstain when material availability is unknown.
strategies.risk: A shared schedule factor does not prove independence or a profitable rest effect; do not use final minutes as a pregame feature.

strategies.name: Minutes × role · points
strategies.hypothesis: Model participation, minutes and points per minute separately; shrink player rates and include opponent/role context.
strategies.output: P(points > offered line), P(push), and fair decimal price under the documented participation/void contract.
strategies.risk: Season PPG is not a prop distribution; do not train only on the 15 highest scorers. Injury probabilities remain blank without data.

strategies.name: Rebounds / assists distribution
strategies.hypothesis: Model minutes, opportunities and conversion with overdispersion; check calibration separately for each market.
strategies.output: Full predictive count distribution; component totals (PRA) need the joint distribution, not summed independent variances.
strategies.risk: Points/rebounds/assists correlations can change with role and threshold. No sign is assumed.

strategies.name: Cross-game joint-value filter
strategies.hypothesis: Start from independently validated single-game probabilities; estimate shared-day/team uncertainty and test dependence.
strategies.output: Joint win probability vs the actual operator’s combined executable quote; disclose every leg and exposure cluster.
strategies.risk: Different games do NOT automatically mean independence. Product of individual odds is not a verified combined payout.

strategies.name: Same-player points + assists
strategies.hypothesis: Use aligned game-level outcomes and frozen thresholds; validate joint hit probabilities on later games.
strategies.output: Estimate joint hits directly or use a calibrated joint simulation; compare with a same-contract combo quote.
strategies.risk: The retrospective 32-game demo is not gate evidence. Positive raw-stat correlation does not guarantee positive threshold-event correlation.

strategies.name: Teammate / team-total combination
strategies.hypothesis: Simulate shared possessions, minutes, usage and game script; fit conditional residual dependence.
strategies.output: Joint probability of all requested legs; use the operator’s offered settlement and void matrix.
strategies.risk: No presumption that teammates are positively or negatively correlated. Pairwise correlations cannot identify a 3+ leg distribution.

gates.name: Provenance & contract
gates.pass_rule: Official-source receipts for every datum, original publication/capture time, dataset hashes, exact market/line/operator and settlement rules. URL presence is insufficient.
gates.current: Stats snapshots checked; pregame quotes and contracts missing.

gates.name: Temporal integrity
gates.pass_rule: Freeze features, model, selection and calibration before tipoff; join using available_at ≤ cutoff; purged calendar walk-forward folds group every game’s legs.
gates.current: Demo recomputes prior-game history, but no actual pregame record or sealed test exists.

gates.name: Coverage & power
gates.pass_rule: Screen at 500 settled selections, 200 distinct games, 60 dates, plus a predeclared power calculation and missingness/selection-bias audit. Numbers are project policy, not proof of skill.
gates.current: Only one player / 32 games; no market selections or power study.

gates.name: Forecast quality
gates.pass_rule: On a common untouched window, beat both the frozen simple baseline and same-contract de-vigged market in log loss/Brier; inspect reliability bins and intervals. Fit calibrators on earlier data only.
gates.current: Only exploratory scores against neutral p=0.5; no market baseline or reliable calibration sample.

gates.name: Joint dependence
gates.pass_rule: For combos: aligned threshold-hit observations, conditional residual analysis, pair definition/n/date range/CI, Fréchet feasibility and held-out joint calibration; 3+ legs require full joint model. Explicitly N/A for singles only.
gates.current: Descriptive correlations computed; no confirmatory joint validation or executable combo quotes.

gates.name: Executable economics
gates.pass_rule: Price against a captured, actually available operator quote. Include margin, fees, taxes where applicable, limits, partial voids/pushes; do not infer quotes or multiply SGP payouts.
gates.current: No operator snapshots, closing prices or offer/void rules captured.

gates.name: Uncertainty & robustness
gates.pass_rule: Net-return lower 95% date-block-bootstrap bound > 0 after costs on the untouched set; report drawdown, coverage, CLV at identical contracts, and block/season sensitivity. CLV alone is not proof.
gates.current: ROI, CLV and confidence bounds on return remain blank.

gates.name: Selection / multiple testing
gates.pass_rule: Log every trial and variant, including rejected attempts. Apply Holm at familywise α=0.05 to valid predeclared tests; do not recycle the holdout after failures.
gates.current: No confirmatory tests or p-values; all present analyses are exploratory.

gates.name: Forward shadow & risk
gates.pass_rule: Freeze submission before a common future window, collect at least 60 calendar days / 200 distinct games on paper, obey 1 unit/game and 5/day caps and 10-unit drawdown stop; log abstentions.
gates.current: No prospective shadow record. Cash execution disabled.

gates.name: Reproducibility & rights
gates.pass_rule: Reproduce data hashes, forecasts, settlement and score from the frozen run; check source rights, operator/jurisdiction restrictions, reward terms and audit artifacts.
gates.current: Offline reproduction supported. NBA §9(iv) gambling-use restriction confirmed; separate permission and operator authorization absent. Pricing release blocked.
